newsitem.title: USA: United Petroleum expects Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: United Petroleum expects Q1 loss.

text.p: United Petroleum Corp said Wednesday it expected a loss in excess of $13.5 million for the fiscal year ended December 31.
United Petroleum, a holding company and investment company, reported a net income of $180,536 in 1995 on revenues of $13.3 million.
"The exact amount will not be available until completion of the year end audit which is routinely completed in April of each fiscal year," it said.

The company said the size of the loss, which is a combination of operating results and one-time charges, is largely attributable to the cost of the company's funding efforts via the issuance of convertible debentures and a reserve for bad debts.
It said it foresaw an operating loss of about $600,000 and one-time charges of about $2. million for the issue of convertible debentures.
It also said it planned to reserve about $11 million for bad debts.
United Petroleum said it expected "continued" operating losses for at least the first quarter of fiscal year 1997 and possibly the second quarter.

As a result of the figures for the year, the company said it was "evaluating plans for reducing its needs for additional capital; restructuring its debentures; selling certain assets or operations and generally, seeking to return the company to profitability".
